mod_description.name: Spellgems
mod_description.concept: Should stay true to Minecraft's core gameplay loop and aesthetic. Spellcasting is designed to be intuitive and fast-paced, with an emphasis on player skill and creativity rather than complex mechanics or heavy resource grinding. The mod should feel mostly like a natural extension of vanilla Minecraft; mechanics shouldn't feel too overpowered and make vanilla tools obsolete.

items.name: mana root
items.description: A harvestable crop that grows like carrots or potatoes.
items.obtainment: Found in loot chests in generated structures. Once seeds are acquired, it can be farmed on farmland.

items.name: mana essence
items.description: Crafting material and fuel for the mana infuser, obtained by smelting mana root.

items.name: raw spell gem
items.description: Unformed magical crystal made in the mana infuser. Combined with a spell-specific item to create a functional spell gem.

items.name: shimmersteel
items.description: Infused metal made in the mana infuser. Used to craft the wand, astral bow, and several machines, and to repair the wand and bow.

items.name: wand
items.description: Tool used to cast spells from inserted spell gems.

usage.durability: Casting consumes durability. When it runs out, the wand becomes a depleted wand (like a broken elytra) and cannot cast until repaired.
usage.repair: Repaired with shimmersteel. Mending also works.
usage.enchantments: Can take Unbreaking, Mending, and the wand-exclusive Recharge enchantment, which slowly restores durability over time.
usage.spell_slots: Holds a set of spell gems. The player can open a small inventory on the wand to insert, remove, or rearrange gems, cycle the selected gem, and quick-cast from individual slots.

items.name: astral bow
items.description: A magical bow that fires astral (non-physical) arrows without consuming regular arrows. Holds potion gems and applies the selected gem's effect on hit.

usage.gem_slots: Holds a set of potion gems with the same insert / cycle / select flow as the wand.
usage.enchantments: Takes Unbreaking, Mending, and crossbow enchantments. Incompatible with typical bow enchantments.

blocks.name: mana infuser
blocks.description: Machine that infuses vanilla items with mana essence.
blocks.mechanics: Works similarly to a furnace or brewing stand. Mana essence is the fuel. Used to create raw spell gems, shimmersteel, and other infused materials.

blocks.name: spell enchanting table
blocks.description: Machine that applies spell enchantments to spell gems and books.
blocks.mechanics: Layout is similar to the vanilla enchanting table, with a single enchant action. Combat spell gems receive one random modifier and one random strike. Books become spell tomes with a random enchantment of the chosen type. Utility gems receive a matching utility enchantment, often using a specific catalyst (including potions for the potion gem).

blocks.name: spell dispenser
blocks.description: Redstone machine that casts a held spell gem when powered.

mechanics.operation: Holds one spell gem and an internal inventory. On a redstone pulse, it casts toward the block it faces.
mechanics.limitation: Each spell has a cooldown. Triggering it again too soon still fires, then the dispenser burns out and stays disabled for a while.
mechanics.spell_behavior: Self-only spells (such as blink and non-splash potion) play effects but do nothing else. Spells that consume player inventory items draw from the dispenser's inventory instead. Magnet pulls nearby items to the block in front of the dispenser, then absorbs them into its inventory. Wool against any side muffles the dispenser's spell sounds, including a transmute's chime and a greater gem's follow-up. Breaking blocks, harvesting crops, and explosions or lightning from spell enchantments still play their usual sounds.

blocks.name: gem forge
blocks.description: Workstation for combining gems and related items, similar to an anvil.
blocks.mechanics: Two unordered input slots and an output. Matching recipes consume experience. Invalid combinations show an error instead of a result. Spell tomes are applied to spell gems here if the gem does not already have an enchantment of the same type. Certain melee weapons (currently the mace) can be socketed with a nova gem; a new nova replaces one already on the weapon. Putting a socketed weapon in by itself removes the nova. Hitting a living target casts nova on that target. Two different combat gems can be combined into a greater spell gem.

blocks.name: astral barrier
blocks.description: Translucent barrier similar to tinted glass. By default players can walk through and mobs cannot; a redstone pulse flips a connected group of these blocks so mobs can pass and players cannot.
blocks.mechanics: No crafting recipe; available in creative and with commands. Immune to explosions, including the Wither.

spell_gems.use: Cast by using the gem directly, from a wand, from an astral bow (potion gems), or from a spell dispenser.
spell_gems.tooltip: Shows applied spell enchantments. Holding shift also shows short descriptions of the spell and its enchantments.
spell_gems.crafting: Made in two steps: create a raw spell gem in the mana infuser, then combine it with a spell-specific item.

spells.name: projectile
spells.description: Shoots a projectile that deals damage to the target.

spells.name: nova
spells.description: Deals damage and knocks enemies back in an area around the caster.

spells.name: vortex
spells.description: Pulls targets, including loose items, toward the location the caster is pointing at.

greater.name: greater spell gem
greater.description: Two different combat gems combined at the gem forge. Casting uses the first spell; each living target it hits directly then takes the second spell after a short delay. Wand cost and dispenser cooldown are the sum of both spells. Valid pairings are projectile then nova, projectile then vortex, and vortex then nova.

spells.name: blink
spells.description: Teleports the caster a short distance in the direction they are pointing.

spells.name: magnet
spells.description: Pulls loose items in the area toward the caster.

spells.name: place block
spells.description: Places a block from the caster's hotbar onto the targeted face.

spells.name: harvest
spells.description: Harvests mature crops in an area around the caster.

spells.name: plant
spells.description: Plants seeds from the caster's hotbar onto nearby farmland.

spells.name: feed
spells.description: Feeds and breeds nearby animals using items from the caster's inventory.

spells.name: grow
spells.description: Applies bone meal to nearby crops, consuming bone meal from the caster's inventory.

spells.name: geode resonance
spells.description: Jumps between nearby budding geodes, growing clusters and harvesting fully grown ones.

spells.name: potion
spells.description: Enchanted with a potion effect. Casting applies that effect to the caster (or, from the astral bow, to the hit target). Splash and lingering potions are delivered around the caster.

spells.name: transmute
spells.description: Shoots a slower purple projectile. Hitting a block that has a transmute recipe changes it into the result block.

catalyst_books.name: spell tome
catalyst_books.description: Books that hold a spell enchantment. Applied to spell gems at the gem forge if the gem does not already have an enchantment of the same type (modifier or strike).

combat.application: Random modifier plus random strike on an unenchanted combat gem, or a chosen type on a book (producing a spell tome). Applied at the spell enchanting table.

modifier.description: Changes how a combat spell is delivered. Each modifier only works on certain spells.

enchantments.name: chaining
enchantments.description: After hitting a target, jumps to other nearby targets.

enchantments.name: multishot
enchantments.description: Fires several copies of the spell in a cone.

enchantments.name: split
enchantments.description: On hit, splits into additional projectiles that continue forward and can split again.

enchantments.name: piercing
enchantments.description: The spell passes through targets in its path.

enchantments.name: power
enchantments.description: Deals additional damage.

enchantments.name: burst
enchantments.description: Fires the spell several times in quick succession.

enchantments.name: expand
enchantments.description: Increases the area of effect.

strike.description: On-hit effects for combat spells. Basic strikes apply a status; combo strikes trigger when the target already has a related status.

enchantments.name: flame
enchantments.description: Sets targets on fire.

enchantments.name: frost
enchantments.description: Applies a freezing effect.

enchantments.name: poison
enchantments.description: Applies poison.

enchantments.name: slow
enchantments.description: Applies slowness.

enchantments.name: levitate
enchantments.description: Applies levitation.

enchantments.name: weaken
enchantments.description: Applies Weakness.

enchantments.name: glow
enchantments.description: Applies Glowing.

enchantments.name: shatter
enchantments.description: If the target is freezing, explodes and freezes nearby enemies.

enchantments.name: combust
enchantments.description: If the target is on fire, explodes and ignites nearby enemies.

enchantments.name: judgement
enchantments.description: If the target is glowing, deals extra damage and applies Weakness to nearby enemies.

enchantments.name: root
enchantments.description: If the target has Weakness, creates a cloud that roots (strong slowness) and applies wither.

enchantments.name: vampiric mist
enchantments.description: If the target has Weakness, creates a mist that periodically damages nearby enemies and heals the caster.

enchantments.name: inferno
enchantments.description: If the target is burning or withered, creates a fiery area that applies burning, wither, and slowness.

enchantments.name: frostbite
enchantments.description: If the target is freezing or withered, creates a chilling area that applies freezing, wither, and slowness.

enchantments.name: plague
enchantments.description: If the target is poisoned or withered, creates a toxic area that applies poison, wither, and slowness.

enchantments.name: lightning
enchantments.description: If the target is slowed or levitating, strikes it with lightning.

enchantments.name: explosion
enchantments.description: If the target is slowed or levitating, explodes on it.

enchantments.name: drain
enchantments.description: Heals the caster for every struck target.

enchantments.name: purify
enchantments.description: If the target is poisoned or withered, applies burning, freezing, and levitation.

enchantments.name: volley
enchantments.description: If the target is slowed or levitating, astral arrows rain down around it.

enchantments.name: vengeance
enchantments.description: Deals extra damage based on how low the caster's health is.

enchantments.name: wind charge
enchantments.description: On hit, creates a wind-charge burst on the target.

utility.application: Applied deterministically at the spell enchanting table, often with a matching catalyst.

enchantments.name: smelt
enchantments.description: Smelts items obtained by the spell.

enchantments.name: silk touch
enchantments.description: Breaks blocks as if with Silk Touch.

enchantments.name: extend
enchantments.description: Increases Blink range.

enchantments.name: potion effect
enchantments.description: Enchanting a potion gem with a potion stores that effect on the gem.
